title: Does a Merger With iHeartRadio Make Sirius Stock a Buy?
title_zh: 与 iHeartRadio 的合并是否会使 Sirius 股票值得买入？
summary: Reports that iHeartMedia (NASDAQ:IHRT) and Sirius XM Holdings (NASDAQ:SIRI) are in early merger talks immediately sent shockwaves through the audio media space. Investors clearly liked one side of the equation more than the other.
summary_zh: 有关 iHeartMedia（纳斯达克股票代码：IHRT）和 Sirius XM Holdings（纳斯达克股票代码：SIRI）正在进行早期合并谈判的报道立即在音频媒体领域引起了震动。投资者显然更喜欢等式的一侧而不是另一侧。

title: Morningstar Says Software Stocks Haven't Been This Undervalued In 3 Years. These 3 Look Like Good Deals.
title_zh: 晨星公司表示，软件股票三年来从未被低估过。这 3 个看起来很划算。
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) disruption is a real threat, but investors are panicking about its impact on these companies.
summary_zh: 人工智能 (AI) 颠覆是一个真正的威胁，但投资者对其对这些公司的影响感到恐慌。

title: After the S&P 500's Historic Comeback, Should You Wait to Buy Stocks? History Offers a Clear Answer
title_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数历史性卷土重来后，您应该等待购买股票吗？历史给出了明确的答案
summary: Can the market keep climbing after a historic April?
summary_zh: 在经历了历史性的四月之后，市场能否继续攀升？

title: AVGO's Google Deal Aids Infrastructure Software Growth: What's Ahead?
title_zh: AVGO 与 Google 的交易有助于基础设施软件的增长：未来是什么？
summary: Broadcom teams up with Google Cloud to launch Cloud Network Insights, offering end-to-end observability for multi-cloud, hybrid and SaaS environments.
summary_zh: Broadcom 与 Google Cloud 合作推出 Cloud Network Insights，为多云、混合和 SaaS 环境提供端到端可观察性。

title: Firestone Country Club ownership could change as part of $3B deal
title_zh: 作为 30 亿美元交易的一部分，Firestone 乡村俱乐部的所有权可能会发生变化
summary: Private equity firm KSL Capital Partners seeks to buy Invited Clubs — which has Firestone Country Club and Silver Lake County Club in its holdings.
summary_zh: 私募股权公司 KSL Capital Partners 寻求收购 Invited Clubs，该俱乐部旗下拥有凡士通乡村俱乐部 (Firestone Country Club) 和银湖乡村俱乐部 (Silver Lake County Club)。
